name: MV Premium

seo.title: MV Premium, Amazon Clipper Cruises, Manaus | James Wild & Co
seo.description: MV Premium by Amazon Clipper: 16 outside cabins for 32 guests, sailing two to five nights from Manaus on the Rio Negro and Amazon, through Anavilhanas.

tagline: Sixteen outside cabins from Manaus, up the Rio Negro.
answer: MV Premium is Amazon Clipper Cruises' largest boat, sailing from Manaus in the Brazilian Amazon. She carries 32 guests in 16 outside cabins over four decks. Cruises run two nights on the Amazon River, three nights on the Rio Negro through Anavilhanas National Park, or five nights combining both. Amazon Clipper publishes no fares; ask us for a quote.
facts: 16 outside cabins (14 to 15.75 sq m), 2 with balcony, 2 triple options
overview: Amazon Clipper says it pioneered boat cruises from Manaus. MV Premium is its comfort boat: 16 outside cabins with two lower beds or a queen, private bathroom with hot shower, air conditioning and a safe; two on the restaurant deck have balconies.
Meals are buffet in an air-conditioned dining room. There is a covered leisure deck, a lecture room and a sun deck.
why: The simplest way to put the Rio Negro and Anavilhanas into a Brazil trip, with short sailings from Manaus.

itineraries.name: 3-night Negro River Cruise

days.title: Boarding
days.summary: Meet at 14:00, board and head up the Rio Negro; an evening canoe into small creeks for caimans and frogs.

days.title: Anavilhanas
days.summary: Early canoe for parrots and toucans, a jungle walk and a swim, then the channels of Anavilhanas National Park.

days.title: Community
days.summary: Piranha fishing, then a visit to a local community to see Amazon fruits and manioc preparation.
